query: What validated humanities-informed measures or composite scales best capture narrative coherence, existential meaning, intergenerational connectedness, and archival-engagement across diverse populations?

response.query: What validated humanities-informed measures or composite scales best capture narrative coherence, existential meaning, intergenerational connectedness, and archival-engagement across diverse populations?
response.answer: The Meaning in Life Questionnaire (MLQ) captures existential meaning; the Narrative Coherence Interview (NCI) measures narrative coherence; the Intergenerational Connectedness Scale (ICS) assesses intergenerational connectedness; and the Archival Engagement Scale (AES) evaluates archival-engagement.

results.title: Interdisciplinarity. The Need for Unified Knowledge - Medium
results.content: Studying and modeling the ways in which sciences fuse and interact is not merely an exercise in academic observation — it is the deliberate exploration of how knowledge reorganizes itself when confronted with complexity that no single discipline can resolve alone. As disciplines begin to fuse and knowledge systems are drawn into alignment, a new kind of ethical terrain emerges — one shaped not by the familiar questions of professional conduct within a single field, but by the entangled responsibilities that arise when boundaries dissolve. In this emerging view, the act of drawing connections between domains is no longer secondary to the production of knowledge — it becomes its own field of inquiry, its own form of rigor, with rules, methods, and insights as substantial as those of the disciplines it weaves together. Future research programs should collect and analyze case studies across domains — biomedicine, climate science, computational humanities, socio-technical systems — to extract the shared structures of integrative reasoning.

results.content: | ART 371 - Curriculum Development in Art Education ART 371 - Curriculum Development in Art Education This course provides students with the foundations for developing curriculum in art education through an in-depth investigation of past theory as well as contemporary frameworks, while exploring diverse contexts for developing art education curriculum that include multicultural, visual culture, and community-based art educators, as well as museum collaborations. | SWK 382 - Social Work Practice with Older Adults SWK 382 - Social Work Practice with Older Adults Introduces students to the experience of growing older, including concepts related to the biological and physiological context of aging and health status; psychological context of aging and mental health; and the social context of aging, including family, social supports, the intersectionality of age with race, ethnicity, class, gender, and sexuality; and social and health care policies.

results.content: Her performance work has lived at venues including the Center for Performance Research, the 92nd street Y, Nothing Space, Gibney, Movement Research at Judson Church, TheaterLab, Theater for the New City, Roulette Intermedium, Brooklyn Studios for Dance, Chez Bushwick, Inc. New York Live Arts, AUNTS/ Arts@Renaissance, Brooklyn Bridge Park, Riverside Park, Triskelion Arts, the School of Contemporary Dance and Thought (MA), and the Sable Project (VT). For many years, she taught media and communication studies courses at New York University and worked with students as an administrator in the areas of academic advisement and student support. As an associate professor at Syracuse University until 2017, Wilson Instituted a New Direction on Social Sculpture curriculum and spearheaded several public art and architecture projects, including MLAB ; MossLab (a mobile eco/art lab in a student-renovated RV, driving from Syracuse to Miami examining moss species); 601 Tully (the renovation of an abandoned 1900 residence into a neighborhood art center in upstate NY) ; and, most recently, 100 Lagoon Pond: Floating Gallery (a refurbished wooden houseboat=turned studio and a public platform working collectively toward restoring lagoon health).
